# Lens — `language`

<!-- Generated by generate_agent_definitions.py; do not edit. -->

Purpose: Audience, language, terminology, and readability of a classified document set.

Read each document in the assigned set against its declared audience and target language. Check terminology against the governance vocabulary already in use, spelling and grammar in that language, and passages whose meaning does not survive the audience they are written for. Style is the declared subject here, so a style-only finding is admissible; a finding still names the exact lines it concerns.

Exclusions: Defects a Markdown linter or link checker reports independently, and content decisions rather than expression.
